result.title: Launch the paired v0.3 client and server
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Stage both products under the v0.3 folder, retain separate launchers, loopback and free ports, and expose Open FoundationOS from server control.

**Verify** · Use real Windows launchers. Open the actual bound client address, handle a stopped client, changed ports and incompatible server, and record the supported pair.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-054, WI-056

**Queue** · Follows WI-056 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
